layout.canvas: Content-aligned 56px square grid; background-position: calc((100vw - var(--solo-width)) / 2) 0.
layout.container: min(1120px, calc(100vw - 112px)); calc(100vw - 64px) at 1100px; calc(100vw - 40px) at 600px.
layout.desktop: At maximum width: 504px + 112px + 504px, spanning twenty grid cells.
layout.responsive: Hero, calendar and report stories stack at 800px; app and offer stack at 600px. Report restores copy-first DOM order.
layout.separation: Grid and whitespace separate page sections and rows; retain contained outlines, selected-state markers and calendar hour rules.

Does the AI need the cloud?

No. The local edition includes a model that analyses sensitive screen context on your device. Optional cloud services and connections to external AI are separate choices and can send selected data to those services.

components.name: App guide
components.description: Native widescreen guide player with an idle poster, user-controlled playback, optional English captions and a responsive chapters/transcript note.
components.html:
English narration and captions. FlowSight 6.1.0 with illustrative demo data; optional Cloud features depend on your plan.

Chapters and transcript

narrative.overview:
FlowSight Solo uses the white, navy and teal identity of the user-pinned FlowSight website. A faint technical grid holds the page together; generous space, direct Geist headlines and clear state changes keep the product explanation readable. White surfaces give the interactive example, calendar and report a quiet place within the grid. Actual app captures retain their own appearance.

This system covers the shared landing at `/` and `/offer-preview`. White appearance is deliberate under either OS theme. The landing CSS module, its demonstration, capability and example components, and the local fonts define the implemented system; unrelated legacy global styles and other application routes do not. Page sequence, offer behaviour and evidence belong in the [surface brief](.impeccable/surfaces/src-app-offer-preview-page-tsx.md). The established north star is retained for this documentation refresh.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white ground with a faint, content-aligned technical grid.
Navy Geist headlines, accessible teal states and restrained brand teal.
Open section spacing, with outlines reserved for controls and contained examples.
Distinct framing for actual app captures and illustrative website components.
Visible keyboard focus, native interactions and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The White Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the landing white under either OS theme. The technical grid is part of the confirmed identity.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Use accessible teal for text, focus and selected states. Brand teal supports the identity; it does not replace the darker text accent. Product captures retain the application's original colours.

rules.name: The Brand Rule
rules.body: Spell the visible name FlowSight, with this exact capitalization, including examples and captions.

rules.name: The Open Section Rule
rules.body: Let the grid and whitespace separate sections and rows. Do not reintroduce divider rules across the header, principles, sections, product tabs, comparison rows, tools, connections, FAQ, closing or footer. Preserve control outlines, selected-state markers and calendar hour rules.

rules.name: The Product Depth Rule
rules.body: Use the ambient shadow for the full app window. Organise the surrounding interface through spacing, contained outlines and tonal surfaces.

dos: Do keep the exact visible spelling FlowSight in page copy, captions, metadata and component specimens.
Do retain the white appearance and content-aligned technical grid under either OS theme.
Do use accessible teal for meaningful states and preserve visible keyboard focus.
Do distinguish authentic app captures from illustrative website calendars and reports.
Do preserve native semantics, responsive reading order and reduced-motion support.
Do retain local control outlines, selected-state markers and calendar hour rules.
donts: Don't introduce an automatic dark palette into this landing.
Don't replace the requested grid with a plain field or another decorative texture.
Don't add divider rules to the open page sections and rows.
Don't recolour or reconstruct the actual product UI to match the landing palette.
Don't imply an illustrative interaction, calendar, report or fixture-backed capture is a live AI session or a measured customer result.
Don't make the static calendar dates, events or report marks look actionable.
Don't use compact example annotations or screenshot captions as the default size for explanatory copy.
